before.scope: Slicer beat-domain/owner integration with controlled transport collaborator; actual browser/audio verified separately.

tests.name: Warped eight-beat domain and pad4 half-slice use continuous beat coordinates
Quantization is a fraction of the selected slice, not always one base beat
Fixed domain survives cursor movement and pad release
Release before preparation finishes returns a paused audition without resurrection
Stop/cancel invalidates pending preparation and late release
Older overlapping-pad release cannot terminate the newer owner
A newer shifting-domain pad uses the advancing root clock while an older slice loops
